inlines.v: PITU'ITARY, adjective [Latin pituita, phlegm, rheum; Gr. to spit.] That secretes phlegm or mucus; as the pituitary membrane. The pituitary gland is a small oval body on the lower side of the brain, supposed by the ancients to secrete the mucus of the nostrils.
